statement: On fresh independent matrices at N_DIM ∈ {16,24,32,40,50}, the Fisher combination of the five per-slice Spearman p-values for (ω(A), M1) is significant at α=0.05.

fresh_seed_policy.rule: Zero overlap with previously used seed index ranges in the ω(A)/κ(V)/pseudospectral arc
rng_independence_checks: SeedSequence([n_dim, seed]) — not seed-alone shared stream across N_DIM
Assert chosen seeds ∩ excluded index sets = ∅

primary_criterion.multiplicity: Fisher combination is the single primary test; per-slice α=0.05 reported as secondary only

decision_rule.WEAKENED: not used for primary (binary confirmatory by design; may appear only as scope note)

kill_criterion: If fisher_combined_p >= 0.05 on this fresh range, reject the claim that the H-B2-1n exploratory Fisher signal is a stable replicable combined effect under this confirmatory design. Do not fall back to majority-of-slices or exploratory upgrades after seeing data.
anti_overfitting: Do not use H-B2-1n exploratory Fisher p=0.013 as confirmation
Do not change α, N_DIM set, or seed range after unblinding results
H-B2-1o prior CONFIRMED is background, not this mission's outcome
secondary_descriptive_only: optional partial-conjunction k-of-5 (walled off from verdict)
